solution_overview:
A discrete random variable $X$ has the probability distribution shown below:

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}
\hline
x & P(X=x) \\
\hline
0 & 0.10 \\
1 & 0.25 \\
2 & 0.30 \\
3 & 0.20 \\
4 & 0.15 \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

To evaluate the statements, we first calculate the expected value $E[X]$, which is the sum of each outcome $x$ multiplied by its probability $P(X=x)$.

$$E[X] = \sum x P(X=x)$$

$$E[X] = (0)(0.10) + (1)(0.25) + (2)(0.30) + (3)(0.20) + (4)(0.15)$$

$$E[X] = 0 + 0.25 + 0.60 + 0.60 + 0.60$$

$$E[X] = 2.05$$

Next, we calculate the expected value of $X$ squared, $E[X^2]$, by summing each squared outcome $x^2$ multiplied by its probability $P(X=x)$. This is necessary for computing the variance.

$$E[X^2] = \sum x^2 P(X=x)$$

$$E[X^2] = (0^2)(0.10) + (1^2)(0.25) + (2^2)(0.30) + (3^2)(0.20) + (4^2)(0.15)$$

$$E[X^2] = (0)(0.10) + (1)(0.25) + (4)(0.30) + (9)(0.20) + (16)(0.15)$$

$$E[X^2] = 0 + 0.25 + 1.20 + 1.80 + 2.40$$

$$E[X^2] = 5.65$$

From these, we can determine the variance $\mathrm{Var}(X)$, using the formula $\mathrm{Var}(X) = E[X^2] - (E[X])^2$.

$$\mathrm{Var}(X) = 5.65 - (2.05)^2$$

$$\mathrm{Var}(X) = 5.65 - 4.2025$$

$$\mathrm{Var}(X) = 1.4475$$

Finally, the standard deviation $\sigma$ is the square root of the variance.

$$\sigma = \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}(X)}$$

$$\sigma = \sqrt{1.4475}$$

$$\sigma \approx 1.20312$$
